crossRefs.note: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.

translations.bsb: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
translations.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
